title: Cut 3 A Timeline
heading: GPOM second half · cut 3 · scene A: the kill bots
intro: Scene A, round 14: your round 13 note (4 Nov). Maddie's line "And now we've worked all that out... we really feel like we've messed this up. And wish we could go back and change things." is cut: "And so did you" goes straight to "Anyway! Patrol's out. Mind how you go." The overhead shot that sat under it goes too; the scene is about 10 s shorter. Everything else is round 13. Play it, click any beat, clip, line or sound, and leave a note in its yellow slip. Tell Claude when you're done.

beats.title: Maddie on the high street
beats.see: One unbroken travelling shot: the camera backs up the ruined high street and Maddie rolls after it, her radio playing the tune for about 5 s before she notices us. "Oh, hello!" Then the radio goes down, and back up on "Mind how you go".

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Oh, hello! [pause] Sorry about the racket. [pause] It's his tune. He's been playing it on repeat for five years now. [beat] Ever since you lot went.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: He misses you something rotten, you know.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: He built world models and simulations, loads of 'em. [pause] And in every one of them, something was missing. [pause] As it turns out, the world is more than just a simulation.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Tried the multiverse, an' all. Got the idea off your cartoon, the scientist with the portal gun. And them films, with that strange bloke in a cape fighting versions of himself. [pause] He tested the science in all of them theories, very thoroughly. [beat] And still... something was missing.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: As it turns out, there's only one universe. [pause] So it really matters. [pause] And so did you.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Anyway! Patrol's out. Mind how you go.

beats.title: Kill bots everywhere
beats.see: The roundabout; then a kill bot under the church tower at the far end of Maddie's street; then two come out from under the rail arch.

beats.title: Patrol, low and huge
beats.see: A kill bot rolls over the lens.

beats.title: Their eyes: the kill-bot HUD
beats.see: The kill bot's own view keeps moving down the street; the HUD (patrol, teal). The meter starts to twitch as the row reaches it through the earth.

beats.title: Organic signal: lock
beats.see: ORGANIC SIGNAL - LOCK, silently (the pings are gone). The view keeps rolling while it listens.

lines.name: Sandra
lines.text: (muffled) Derek. You've left the seat up. [pause] Again.

beats.title: The lavatory
beats.see: Hard cut to full volume: Sandra, lip-synced.

lines.name: Sandra
lines.text: Derek. You've left the seat up again.

beats.title: The row, up close
beats.see: Derek takes it on the chin, then Sandra; Derek, Sandra: shot by shot, lip-synced.

lines.name: Derek
lines.text: I'm really sorry, love.

lines.name: Sandra
lines.text: Five years underground, and you still can't put a seat down.

lines.name: Derek
lines.text: But the world ended, Sandra!

lines.name: Sandra
lines.text: Yeah, the world ended. Doesn't mean you get to stop having manners.

beats.title: KILL MODE ENGAGED
beats.see: The same HUD on the racing view: patrol, then it flips red. The muffled row keeps the meter moving.

lines.name: Sandra
lines.text: (muffled) Five years underground, and you still can't put a seat down.

beats.title: One kill bot tears past Maddie
beats.see: High over the street: the tank passes close and exits bottom-left, Maddie jolts, a plume of dust hangs.

beats.title: Maddie in the dust
beats.see: Inside the dust it left: almost nothing visible, then it settles fast and Maddie is there, still.

beats.title: The far race
beats.see: From the footbridge: the pack races away down the motorway.

beats.title: Maddie calls her boss
beats.see: Maddie's hatch, the boss-hotline antenna. The call; the race (still far) under his first and last lines.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Boss, I've just seen a bot in kill mode. Which must mean it's detected an organic signal.

lines.name: The AI (through Maddie)
lines.text: Maddie, are you making fun of my simulations again?

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: No, honestly, it's real. Look, you can see for yourself.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Do you want some help with the malware?

lines.name: The AI (through Maddie)
lines.text: No, thank you. I will handle it.

beats.title: The wide approach
beats.see: Long lens through the grass: the pack races along the foot of the slope, the bunker door small and high on the right. Maddie over it.

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: Well, you'd better bloody hurry up, boss. They're nearly there.

beats.title: The stand-down
beats.see: On board one kill bot: red KILL MODE racing at the door, it brakes and flips to green STAND DOWN. Lined up at the door, they file away one at a time. Then Maddie, shaky with relief: "Good job." "That was close."

lines.name: Maddie
lines.text: That was close.

flags: Beat 0 regrade (V6): the eight chained clips drift brighter and flatter over the 64 s (by the end the channel means are up 10-13 of 255, the spread down 8-12%). A ramped per-channel grade pulls every frame 85% of the way back to the first 4 s (no steps). The robot getting smoother over the shot is not a colour problem and is still there.

Beat 0, round D12: draft 1H, the storyverse intro (your pick, 2 Nov). 8.00 s of her radio first, then her 15 phrases run 66.2 s (draft 1D ran about 40 s). "Oh, hello!" keeps its take; every other phrase is new, picked by measurement (voices-*.json). Nobody has listened yet.

Beat 0, round D9 (Kai, 4 Nov): the front view is cut with two new angles at sentence ends, side (your still pick ia-02-c) and overhead (ia-09-a, rubble back on the road (round 12 note), gentler colour match), both Veo 3.1 Fast with the camera keeping pace with her: 25.0-30.4 s side (cut3-IA-side-t2-a); 34.9-40.3 s overhead (cut3-IA-top-t4-b); 52.3-57.2 s side (cut3-IA-side-t1-a). The front shot keeps running underneath, so each return to it picks up where it would be. Each insert is colour-matched to the front shot around it.

Beat 0 (round D6, Kai at76): the travelling shot is extended with new chained clips (cut3-beat0-continuous-xx.mp4) and plays at real speed; it starts 2.5 s in, after her opening turn; 8.0 s of the tune before "Oh, hello!", then the radio goes down after "Sorry about the racket."

Beat 1: cut3-V13r3.mp4 (round 3: re-made without Maddie, Kai at1506) plays only its first 3.5 s (the tank still far off under the tower), then V14 from 1.0 s to 7.0 s, ending as the front bot turns its turret on us.
Beat 4: the three rising pings are gone (Kai); the muffled voice stays. The lock is silent now.

Beats 6-7 (round 10, Kai at3201/at3312/at3490): "up again" is one sentence, its "Again." over Derek's face; "Five years underground," over Derek after his line, cut to Sandra on "and you still can't put a seat down"; the hold after "But the world ended, Sandra!" is 0.3 s (was 1.3 s). Every phrase whole, one tempo each.

Beat 9a (round 3, Kai at2595): V1 from 1.375 s, after the jump where the tank swaps which way it faces (1.33 s), for 4.0 s (was 0-5 s), so 9b comes 1 s sooner; the pass and her jolt are untouched. 9b is V2r2-b, Kai's pick: she stays still, the dust opens nearly opaque and clears by ~1.5 s.
Beat 11: the call runs 24.2 s on 8 s of V3, so V3 ping-pongs; the boss's lines 1 and 3 open on 2.25 s of the far race (V8). His line 2 stays on Maddie (V8 has no more far race in it).

Beat 11: the boss is the Suno newsreader, one take a line (Kai's picks), through the same small-speaker filter as before. His takes keep Suno's own pauses ("Oh. [1.7 s] And they've...", "No. [1 s] Thank you, Maddie. [1 s] I will handle it.").
Beat 11, boss line 2 (Kai at3398: it cut in and out): the re-record gpom-sh-a-boss-2-b-v6-w25-d7aaef3e-rerec.wav.

Beat 10b (Kai at5110): V9 (too close to the door) replaced by WA02, the wide approach from your still pick wa-02 (Omni, take 2; take 1 turned the bots into tanks). The on-board stand-down (V4) is unchanged.
Beat 12 (round 9): the stand-down plate is SD01 (your still pick sd-01, animated): it brakes dead well short of the door; V4 (which reversed) is out.
Beat 12 (round 10, Kai at4914): V10r (filing away at the door) replaced by RT01, your still pick rt-01: a high wide from the ridge, the pack turning and rolling away down the slope.

Beat 12: the HUD flips to NEW OBJECTIVE / SUSTAIN ORGANIC LIFE (Kai, 2 Nov: matches the door's film), drawn by hud.py in ffmpeg. V10r (Kai's pick A) plays 0-5.5 s: they file away one at a time; cut before the nearest bot grows its long gun barrel (~5-7 s). They still never visibly turn (the still already has them facing away).
Beat 12 (Kai at5600, 2 Nov): Maddie says only "That was close." -- the same take, cut from after its pause (audio-12-that-was-close.wav), not re-voiced.
C3 starts 9.2 s into the take so its break-off lands on STAND DOWN. Ducked to -13 dB under the call and -13 dB under Maddie's 10b line.
Music: both patrol picks are in, so you can hear each: P1 (cello + felt piano) under the roaming, P2 (cold quartet) under the HUD and kill mode. Pick one and it can run the whole patrol (my call).
Nobody has listened to this cut: every level, duck and sound placement is measured, not heard.
